title.en: Unit 8: Scholars, the Extra Ba, and Stories
title.ur: Ikayi 8: Ulama, Ziyada Ba aur Qissay

title.en: Scholars who won the King Faisal Prize
title.ur: King Faisal Award jeetne wale ulama

intro.en: In this lesson you read short biographies of three well-known scholars who served Islam: Ibn Baz, al-Tantawi and Ahmad Deedat. Read slowly, sentence by sentence, and notice the words for study, teaching and da'wah.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum teen mashhoor ulama ki mukhtasar seerat parhenge jinhon ne Islam ki khidmat ki: Ibn Baz, Tantawi aur Ahmad Deedat. Aahista aahista, jumla ba jumla parhein aur parhai, tadrees aur dawat ke alfaz par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: في هَذا الدَّرْسِ تَقْرَأُ سِيَرًا قَصيرَةً لِثَلاثَةِ عُلَماءَ خَدَموا الإِسْلامَ: ابْنِ بازٍ وَالطَّنْطاوِيِّ وَأَحْمَدَ ديدات. اِقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً، وَانْتَبِهْ لِكَلِماتِ الدِّراسَةِ وَالتَّعْليمِ وَالدَّعْوَةِ.

dialogue.ar: نالَ جائِزَةَ المَلِكِ فَيْصَلٍ لِخِدْمَةِ الإِسْلامِ بَعْضُ العُلَماءِ المَشْهورينَ.
dialogue.tr: nāla jā'izata l-maliki Fayṣalin li-khidmati l-islām baʿḍu l-ʿulamā'i l-mashhūrīn
dialogue.en: Some famous scholars won the King Faisal Prize for serving Islam.
dialogue.ur: King Faisal Award Islam ki khidmat par kuch mashhoor ulama ko mila.

dialogue.ar: وُلِدَ الشَّيْخُ عَبْدُ العَزيزِ بنُ بازٍ في الرِّياضِ.
dialogue.tr: wulida sh-shaykhu ʿAbdu l-ʿAzīzi bnu Bāzin fi r-Riyāḍ
dialogue.en: Sheikh Abdul Aziz ibn Baz was born in Riyadh.
dialogue.ur: Shaikh Abdul Aziz bin Baz Riyadh mein paida hue.

dialogue.ar: حَفِظَ القُرْآنَ الكَريمَ قَبْلَ سِنِّ البُلوغِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥafiẓa l-qur'āna l-karīma qabla sinni l-bulūgh
dialogue.en: He memorised the Noble Quran before reaching puberty.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne baligh hone se pehle Quran Majeed hifz kar liya.

dialogue.ar: عَمِلَ في القَضاءِ مُدَّةَ أَرْبَعَةَ عَشَرَ عاماً.
dialogue.tr: ʿamila fi l-qaḍā'i muddata arbaʿata ʿashara ʿāmā
dialogue.en: He worked in the judiciary for fourteen years.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne chaudah saal qaza (adalat) mein kaam kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَوُلِدَ الشَّيْخُ عَلِيٌّ الطَّنْطاوِيُّ في مَدينَةِ دِمَشْقَ.
dialogue.tr: wa wulida sh-shaykhu ʿAliyyun aṭ-Ṭanṭāwiyyu fī madīnati Dimashq
dialogue.en: Sheikh Ali al-Tantawi was born in the city of Damascus.
dialogue.ur: Shaikh Ali Tantawi Damishq shehar mein paida hue.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ لَهُ بَرامِجُ في الإِذاعَةِ وَالتِّلْفازِ.
dialogue.tr: kānat lahu barāmiju fi l-idhāʿati wa t-tilfāz
dialogue.en: He had programmes on radio and television.
dialogue.ur: Unke radio aur television par programme the.

dialogue.ar: وَالشَّيْخُ أَحْمَدُ دِيدات داعِيَةٌ إِسْلامِيٌّ مِنْ جَنوبِ إِفْريقِيا.
dialogue.tr: wa sh-shaykhu Aḥmadu Dīdāt dāʿiyatun islāmiyyun min janūbi Ifrīqiyā
dialogue.en: Sheikh Ahmad Deedat was an Islamic preacher from South Africa.
dialogue.ur: Shaikh Ahmad Deedat Junubi Afreeqa ke ek Islami dai the.

dialogue.ar: عَقَدَ مُناظَراتٍ عَديدَةً مَعَ خُصومِ الإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿaqada munāẓarātin ʿadīdatan maʿa khuṣūmi l-islām
dialogue.en: He held many debates with opponents of Islam.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne Islam ke mukhalifeen se kai munazray kiye.

q.ur: «جائِزَةٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: ما يُعْطى لِمَنْ يَتَفَوَّقُ تَكْريمًا لَهُ

q.en: Where was Sheikh Ibn Baz born, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Shaikh Ibn Baz kahan paida hue?
q.ar: أَيْنَ وُلِدَ الشَّيْخُ ابْنُ بازٍ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Which scholar was from South Africa?
q.ur: Kaun sa aalim Junubi Afreeqa se tha?
q.ar: أَيُّ العُلَماءِ كانَ مِنْ جَنوبِ أَفْريقِيا؟

q.ur: «مُناظَرَةٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: حِوارٌ بَيْنَ شَخْصَيْنِ يُدافِعُ كُلٌّ عَنْ رَأْيِهِ

q.ur: "University" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى مَكانِ الدِّراسَةِ العالِيَةِ؟

title.ar: قَواعِدُ اللُّغَةِ: زِيادَةُ «الباءِ» في خَبَرِ «لَيْسَ» وَ«ما»
title.en: Grammar: the extra «ba» in the predicate of «laysa» and «ma»
title.ur: Qawaid: «laysa» aur «ma» ki khabar mein ziyada «ba»

intro.en: After «لَيْسَ» or «ما» (meaning 'is not'), the predicate (khabar) can take an extra letter «بِ» in front of it. It adds emphasis, and the word after it ends with a kasra. Example: «لَسْتُ مُخْلِفاً» or «لَسْتُ بِمُخْلِفٍ» – both mean 'I do not break my promise'.
intro.ur: «لَيْسَ» ya «ما» (yaani 'nahin') ke baad khabar se pehle ek ziyada harf «بِ» aa sakta hai. Isse baat mein zor aa jata hai aur khabar ke aakhir mein kasra aata hai. Misal: «لَسْتُ مُخْلِفاً» ya «لَسْتُ بِمُخْلِفٍ» – dono ka matlab hai 'main wada khilafi nahin karta'.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ «لَيْسَ» أَوْ «ما» النّافِيَةِ يَجوزُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ حَرْفُ «بِ» الزّائِدُ عَلى الخَبَرِ لِلتَّوْكيدِ، وَيَكونُ الخَبَرُ بَعْدَهُ مَجْرورًا بِالكَسْرَةِ. مِثالٌ: «لَسْتُ مُخْلِفاً» أَوْ «لَسْتُ بِمُخْلِفٍ»، وَالمَعْنى واحِدٌ.

dialogue.ar: لَسْتُ بِمُخْلِفٍ مَوْعِدي.
dialogue.tr: lastu bi-mukhlifin mawʿidī
dialogue.en: I am not one who breaks my appointment.
dialogue.ur: Main apna wada khilaf karne wala nahin.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ المُؤْمِنُ بِلَعّانٍ وَلا بِطَعّانٍ.
dialogue.tr: laysa l-mu'minu bi-laʿʿānin wa lā bi-ṭaʿʿān
dialogue.en: The believer is not one who curses or slanders.
dialogue.ur: Momin lanat karne wala aur taan karne wala nahin hota.

dialogue.ar: ما أَنا بِمُغَفَّلٍ.
dialogue.tr: mā anā bi-mughaffal
dialogue.en: I am not a fool.
dialogue.ur: Main bewaqoof nahin hoon.

dialogue.ar: ما المُهْمِلُ بِناجِحٍ.
dialogue.tr: mā l-muhmilu bi-nājiḥ
dialogue.en: The careless person is not successful.
dialogue.ur: Laparwah kamyab nahin hota.

dialogue.ar: ما صاحِبُ الحَقِّ بِضَعيفٍ.
dialogue.tr: mā ṣāḥibu l-ḥaqqi bi-ḍaʿīf
dialogue.en: The one who has the truth is not weak.
dialogue.ur: Haq wala kamzor nahin hota.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ الغِنى بِكَثْرَةِ المالِ.
dialogue.tr: laysa l-ghinā bi-kathrati l-māl
dialogue.en: Richness is not in having a lot of money.
dialogue.ur: Maldari ziyada maal se nahin hoti.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ الفَقْرُ بِعَيْبٍ.
dialogue.tr: laysa l-faqru bi-ʿayb
dialogue.en: Poverty is not a shame.
dialogue.ur: Gareebi koi aib nahin.

dialogue.ar: ما هَذا الفِعْلُ بِمَقْبولٍ مِنْ مِثْلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: mā hādha l-fiʿlu bi-maqbūlin min mithlik
dialogue.en: This deed is not acceptable from someone like you.
dialogue.ur: Aap jaise shakhs se yeh kaam qabil-e-qubool nahin.

q.en: Which sentence has the extra «بِ» in the predicate?
q.ur: Kis jumle ki khabar mein ziyada «بِ» hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ فيها «بِ» الزّائِدَةُ في الخَبَرِ؟

q.en: What is the ending of the word after the extra «بِ»?
q.ur: Ziyada «بِ» ke baad wale lafz ka aakhri harkat kya hoti hai?
q.ar: ما حَرَكَةُ الكَلِمَةِ الَّتي بَعْدَ «بِ» الزّائِدَةِ؟

q.ur: «لَيْسَ الفَقْرُ بِعَيْبٍ» ka matlab kya hai?
"Kamzor" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
Ziyada «بِ» kis ke baad aata hai?

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Zehnon ki hijrat

intro.en: This lesson is about listening to a text on «هِجْرَةُ العُقولِ» (the migration of educated minds from poorer countries to the West). Listen to the audio, then decide which statements are true or false, and finish with a short speaking task.
intro.ur: Yeh sabaq «هِجْرَةُ العُقولِ» yaani parhe likhe logon aur ulama ke ghareeb mulkon se Maghrib ki taraf hijrat ke baare mein sun kar samajhne ka hai. Audio sunein, phir sahih ya ghalat batayein, aur aakhir mein chhota sa guftagu ka kaam karein.
intro.ar: يَدورُ هَذا الدَّرْسُ حَوْلَ نَصٍّ مَسْموعٍ عَنْ «هِجْرَةِ العُقولِ»، أَيِ انْتِقالِ المُتَعَلِّمينَ مِنَ البُلْدانِ الفَقيرَةِ إِلى الغَرْبِ. اِسْتَمِعْ ثُمَّ حَدِّدِ الصَّوابَ وَالخَطَأَ، وَاخْتِمْ بِتَدْريبٍ قَصيرٍ عَلى الكَلامِ.

dialogue.ar: العُلَماءُ سَبَبُ تَطَوُّرِ الأُمَمِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿulamā'u sababu taṭawwuri l-umam
dialogue.en: Scholars are a reason for the progress of nations.
dialogue.ur: Ulama qaumon ki taraqqi ka sabab hain.

dialogue.ar: تَتَأَخَّرُ الأُمَمُ إِذا هَجَرَها عُلَماؤُها.
dialogue.tr: tata'akhkharu l-umamu idhā hajarahā ʿulamā'uhā
dialogue.en: Nations fall behind when their scholars leave them.
dialogue.ur: Jab ulama qaum ko chhor jayein to qaumein pichhad jati hain.

dialogue.ar: يُهاجِرُ العُلَماءُ مِنَ الدُّوَلِ النّامِيَةِ إِلى الدُّوَلِ الغَرْبِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: yuhājiru l-ʿulamā'u mina d-duwali n-nāmiyati ilā d-duwali l-gharbiyya
dialogue.en: Scholars migrate from developing countries to Western countries.
dialogue.ur: Ulama taraqqi pazeer mulkon se Maghribi mulkon ki taraf hijrat karte hain.

dialogue.ar: تَوْفيرُ مَجالاتِ البَحْثِ مِنْ أَسْبابِ مَنْعِ هِجْرَةِ العُقولِ.
dialogue.tr: tawfīru majālāti l-baḥthi min asbābi manʿi hijrati l-ʿuqūl
dialogue.en: Providing fields for research is one way to stop the brain drain.
dialogue.ur: Tehqeeq ke mauqe faraham karna zehnon ki hijrat rokne ka ek sabab hai.

dialogue.ar: حاوِرْ زَميلَكَ: التَّعْليمُ في الماضي أَوِ التَّعْليمُ في الحاضِرِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥāwir zamīlak: at-taʿlīmu fi l-māḍī awi t-taʿlīmu fi l-ḥāḍir
dialogue.en: Talk with your classmate: education in the past or education today.
dialogue.ur: Apne saathi se baat karein: maazi ki taleem ya aaj ki taleem.

q.ur: «هِجْرَةُ العُقولِ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: انْتِقالُ العُلَماءِ وَالمُتَعَلِّمينَ مِنْ بُلْدانِهِمْ إِلى بُلْدانٍ أُخْرى

q.ur: "Tehqeeq" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى دِراسَةٍ عِلْمِيَّةٍ لِمَعْرِفَةِ شَيْءٍ؟

q.ur: «الدُّوَلُ النّامِيَةُ» ka matlab:
«الوَطَنُ» ka matlab kya hai?

title.ar: قَواعِدُ اللُّغَةِ: كَفُّ «إِنَّ» وَأَخَواتِها عَنِ العَمَلِ
title.en: Grammar: «ma» stops «inna» and her sisters from working
title.ur: Qawaid: «ma» se «inna» aur uski behnon ka amal ruk jana

intro.en: Normally «إِنَّ» puts the subject in the accusative: «إِنَّ اللهَ إلهٌ واحِدٌ». When «ما» is added after it («إِنَّما»), it stops working, and the noun after it stays in the nominative: «إِنَّما الحَياةُ جِهادٌ». The same happens with «لَكِنَّما», «لَيْتَما» and «كَأَنَّما». «إِنَّما» often means 'only' or 'indeed'.
intro.ur: Aam tor par «إِنَّ» ke baad ka ism mansoob aata hai: «إِنَّ اللهَ إلهٌ واحِدٌ». Jab «ما» laga kar «إِنَّما» ban jaye to «إِنَّ» ka amal ruk jata hai aur uske baad wala lafz marfoo rehta hai: «إِنَّما الحَياةُ جِهادٌ». Yehi «لَكِنَّما»، «لَيْتَما» aur «كَأَنَّما» mein bhi hota hai. «إِنَّما» ka matlab aksar 'sirf' ya 'bila shuba' hota hai.
intro.ar: الأَصْلُ أَنْ تَنْصِبَ «إِنَّ» الاسْمَ: «إِنَّ اللهَ إِلهٌ واحِدٌ». فَإِذا زيدَتْ «ما» بَعْدَها («إِنَّما») كُفَّتْ عَنِ العَمَلِ وَبَقِيَ الاسْمُ مَرْفوعًا: «إِنَّما الحَياةُ جِهادٌ». وَكَذَلِكَ «لَكِنَّما» وَ«لَيْتَما» وَ«كَأَنَّما». وَ«إِنَّما» تُفيدُ الحَصْرَ وَالتَّوْكيدَ.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الحَياةَ جِهادٌ.
dialogue.tr: inna l-ḥayāta jihād
dialogue.en: Life is a struggle.
dialogue.ur: Zindagi jidd-o-jehad hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما الحَياةُ جِهادٌ.
dialogue.tr: innamā l-ḥayātu jihād
dialogue.en: Life is only a struggle. (with «ma»: no change to the noun)
dialogue.ur: Zindagi bas jidd-o-jehad hai. («ma» ke saath ism marfoo rehta hai.)

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما القَناعَةُ كَنْزٌ.
dialogue.tr: innamā l-qanāʿatu kanz
dialogue.en: Contentment is indeed a treasure.
dialogue.ur: Qanaat hi asal khazana hai.

dialogue.ar: سَعيدٌ شُجاعٌ وَلَكِنَّما أَخوهُ جَبانٌ.
dialogue.tr: Saʿīdun shujāʿun wa lākinnamā akhūhu jabān
dialogue.en: Saeed is brave, but his brother is a coward.
dialogue.ur: Saeed bahadur hai lekin uska bhai buzdil hai.

dialogue.ar: أَلا لَيْتَما الشَّبابُ يَعودُ يَوْماً.
dialogue.tr: alā laytamā sh-shabābu yaʿūdu yawmā
dialogue.en: If only youth would return one day.
dialogue.ur: Kaash jawani kisi din laut aaye.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما يُعاقَبُ المُسيءُ.
dialogue.tr: innamā yuʿāqabu l-musī'
dialogue.en: Only the wrongdoer is punished.
dialogue.ur: Sirf bura kaam karne wale ko saza di jati hai.

dialogue.ar: قُلْ إِنَّما يُوحى إِلَيَّ أَنَّما إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ واحِدٌ.
dialogue.tr: qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥid
dialogue.en: Say: it is only revealed to me that your God is One God. (from the Quran)
dialogue.ur: Kahiye: mujh par wahi ki jati hai ke tumhara mabood ek hi mabood hai. (Quran se)

vocab.en: a particle that changes the sentence (like inna)

q.ur: «إِنَّما» ka aam matlab kya hota hai?

q.en: What happens when «ما» is added to «إِنَّ»?
q.ur: «إِنَّ» ke saath «ما» lagane se kya hota hai?

options: It stops working on the noun

q.ur: "Kaash" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
«القَناعَةُ كَنْزٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Three stories with lessons: a man on a plane who is content though poor, Ibrahim ibn Adham and the man who wanted to sin, and the guest at night (a story from the Ansar). Read them slowly and think about the lesson in each. Story 3 includes the words of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, as in the book.
intro.ur: Teen sabaq amoz qissay: ek ghareeb aadmi jo hawai jahaz mein mila magar qanaat wala tha, Ibrahim bin Adham aur gunah karne wala aadmi, aur raat ka mehman (Ansar ka waqia). Aahista parhein aur har qisse ka sabaq sochein. Teesre qisse mein Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ka farman kitab ke alfaz mein hai.
intro.ar: ثَلاثُ قِصَصٍ فيها عِبَرٌ: رَجُلٌ قَنوعٌ في طائِرَةٍ مَعَ فَقْرِهِ، وَإِبْراهيمُ بْنُ أَدْهَمَ وَالرَّجُلُ الَّذي أَرادَ المَعْصِيَةَ، وَضَيْفُ اللَّيْلِ (قِصَّةٌ مِنَ الأَنْصارِ). اِقْرَأْها بِبُطْءٍ وَتَأَمَّلِ العِبْرَةَ في كُلٍّ مِنْها. وَتَتَضَمَّنُ القِصَّةُ الثّالِثَةُ كَلامَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ كَما في الكِتابِ.

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ للهِ عَلى كُلِّ حالٍ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāhi ʿalā kulli ḥāl
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah in every state.
dialogue.ur: Har haal mein Allah ka shukr hai.

dialogue.ar: عَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ مُوَظَّفٌ صَغيرٌ، وَأَنَّهُ أَبٌ لِسَبْعَةِ أَطْفالٍ.
dialogue.tr: ʿaraftu annahu muwaẓẓafun ṣaghīr, wa annahu abun li-sabʿati aṭfāl
dialogue.en: I learned that he was a small employee and the father of seven children.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe pata chala ke woh ek chhota mulazim hai aur saat bachchon ka baap hai.

dialogue.ar: أَشْعُرُ أَنَّني بِنِعْمَةٍ ما دُمْتُ أَدِبُّ عَلى الأَرْضِ، وَعَقْلي مَعي.
dialogue.tr: ashʿuru annanī bi-niʿmatin mā dumtu adibbu ʿalā l-arḍ, wa ʿaqlī maʿī
dialogue.en: I feel I am blessed as long as I walk on the earth and my mind is with me.
dialogue.ur: Main samajhta hoon ke main nemat mein hoon jab tak zameen par chalta hoon aur meri aqal mere saath hai.

dialogue.ar: لا أَمْلِكُ بَيْتاً وَلَكِنَّني مُطْمَئِنٌّ.
dialogue.tr: lā amliku baytan wa lākinnanī muṭma'inn
dialogue.en: I do not own a house, but I am at peace.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas ghar nahin lekin main mutmain hoon.

dialogue.ar: عَلِمَ اللهُ أَنَّني لَمْ أُقَصِّرْ.
dialogue.tr: ʿalima llāhu annanī lam uqaṣṣir
dialogue.en: Allah knows that I did not fall short.
dialogue.ur: Allah janta hai ke maine koi kotahi nahin ki.

dialogue.ar: حَقّاً كَمْ هُوَ عَظيمٌ هَذا الدّينُ!
dialogue.tr: ḥaqqan kam huwa ʿaẓīmun hādha d-dīn
dialogue.en: Truly, how great this religion is!
dialogue.ur: Waqai yeh deen kitna azeem hai!

dialogue.ar: قالَ إِبْراهيمُ: إِذا جاءَكَ مَلَكُ المَوْتِ لِيَقْبِضَ رُوحَكَ فَقُلْ لَهُ: أَخِّرْني حَتّى أَتوبَ تَوْبَةً نَصوحاً.
dialogue.tr: qāla Ibrāhīmu: idhā jā'aka malaku l-mawti li-yaqbiḍa rūḥaka faqul lahu: akhkhirnī ḥattā atūba tawbatan naṣūḥā
dialogue.en: Ibrahim said: when the Angel of Death comes to take your soul, say to him: give me more time until I repent sincerely.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim ne kaha: jab maut ka farishta teri rooh qabz karne aaye to usse keh: mujhe mohlat de taake main sachchi touba karoon.

dialogue.ar: فَلَزِمَ العِبادَةَ، وَاجْتَنَبَ المَعاصي، حَتّى فارَقَ الدُّنْيا.
dialogue.tr: falaziman l-ʿibāda, wa jtanaba l-maʿāṣī, ḥattā fāraqa d-dunyā
dialogue.en: So he stayed devoted to worship and avoided sins until he left this world.
dialogue.ur: Phir woh ibadat par qaim raha aur gunahon se bacha, yahan tak ke dunya se rukhsat hua.

dialogue.ar: عَنِ الحَسَنِ أَنَّ رَجُلاً جَهَدَهُ الجوعُ، فَفَطِنَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصارِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿani l-Ḥasani anna rajulan jahadahu l-jūʿ, fafaṭina lahu rajulun mina l-anṣār
dialogue.en: From al-Hasan: a man was worn out by hunger, and a man from the Ansar noticed him.
dialogue.ur: Hasan se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi bhook se nidhal tha, to Ansar ke ek aadmi ne use dekh liya.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ لَكِ أَنْ نَطْوِيَ لَيْلَتَنا هَذِهِ لِضَيْفِنا؟
dialogue.tr: hal laki an naṭwiya laylatanā hādhihi li-ḍayfinā
dialogue.en: Can we go hungry tonight for the sake of our guest?
dialogue.ur: Kya hum aaj raat apne mehman ke liye bhooke reh sakte hain?

dialogue.ar: فَوَاللهِ لَقَدْ عَجِبَ اللهُ مِنْ صُنْعِكُما اللَّيْلَةَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-wallāhi laqad ʿajiba llāhu min ṣunʿikumā l-layla
dialogue.en: By Allah, Allah was pleased with what you two did tonight. (words of the Prophet, peace be upon him, as in the book)
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam, Allah ko aaj raat tum dono ka amal bahut pasand aaya. (Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ka farman, kitab ke mutabiq)

q.ur: «ضَيْفٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: In the first story, how many children did the man have?
q.ur: Pehle qisse mein us aadmi ke kitne bachche the?
q.ar: كَمْ وَلَدًا كانَ لِلرَّجُلِ في القِصَّةِ الأولى؟

q.ur: «التَّوْبَةُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: In the second story, what did Ibrahim advise the man to ask the Angel of Death for?
q.ur: Doosre qisse mein Ibrahim ne aadmi ko maut ke farishte se kya maangne ko kaha?
q.ar: في القِصَّةِ الثّانِيَةِ، بِمَ نَصَحَ إِبْراهيمُ الرَّجُلَ أَنْ يَطْلُبَ مِنْ مَلَكِ المَوْتِ؟

q.en: In the third story, what did the Ansari and his wife do for their guest?
q.ur: Teesre qisse mein Ansari aur unki biwi ne mehman ke liye kya kiya?
q.ar: في القِصَّةِ الثّالِثَةِ، ماذا فَعَلَ الأَنْصارِيُّ وَزَوْجَتُهُ لِضَيْفِهِما؟

options: Gave him their food and stayed hungry

intro.en: A review test on earlier units. It brings together reading questions on the King Faisal Prize, the history of teaching in the Muslim world (kuttab schools, teachers and the muhtasib), grammar (extra «بِ», «إِنَّما») and word sorting. Use the answers slides to check yourself.
intro.ur: Pichhli ikaiyon ki dohrai ka imtihan. Is mein King Faisal Prize par parhne ke sawal, Islami dunya mein taleem ki tareekh (kuttab, muallim aur muhtasib), qawaid (ziyada «بِ»، «إِنَّما») aur alfaz ki tarteeb shamil hain. Jawab wali slides se apna jawab check karein.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارٌ لِمُراجَعَةِ الوَحَداتِ السّابِقَةِ: أَسْئِلَةُ قِراءَةٍ عَنْ جائِزَةِ المَلِكِ فَيْصَلٍ وَتاريخِ التَّعْليمِ في العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ (الكَتاتيبُ وَالمُعَلِّمونَ وَالمُحْتَسِبُ) وَقَواعِدُ («بِ» الزّائِدَةُ وَ«إِنَّما») وَتَصْنيفُ الكَلِماتِ. اِسْتَعِنْ بِشَرائِحِ الإِجاباتِ لِتَتَحَقَّقَ بِنَفْسِكَ.

q.ur: «الاِخْتِبارُ» ka matlab kya hai?
"Ustaad" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى مَنْ يُعَلِّمُ الطُّلّابَ؟

q.en: Which sentence is correct with the extra «بِ»?
q.ur: Ziyada «بِ» ke saath kaun sa jumla durust hai?
«الحِسابُ» ka matlab kya hai?
